title: Timur moves in
text: A new roommate arrives with a duffel bag, a rice cooker and a big smile. "I am Timur. I work nights. I promise I am quiet."

choices.t: Share dinner with him
choices.then: Plov from his rice cooker, tea from yours. By midnight you are friends.

choices.t: Agree on house rules first
choices.then: Rules on a sheet of paper: dishes, quiet hours, guests. He signs with a flourish.

title: Late-night calls to his mother
text: Every night at 2 a.m. Timur whispers into his phone. You hear a mother's voice, tinny and warm, asking if he has eaten.

choices.t: Offer him the kitchen so he can talk freely
choices.then: He is moved. The next day there is a pot of lagman waiting for you.

choices.t: Ask him to talk quietly
choices.then: He nods and speaks in whispers. Awkward but fine.

title: Timur loses his night job
text: Timur sits on his bunk, staring at his phone. "They let me go. I do not know how I will pay my share this week."

choices.t: Lend him ₽5,000
choices.then: He promises to repay every rouble and means it.

choices.t: Help him look for a job instead
choices.then: You spend an evening on job sites and send his resume to three employers.

choices.t: Say you cannot help right now
choices.then: He swallows his pride and says "no problem". The room is quiet for days.

title: Timur finds work
text: Timur bursts in, waving his phone. "I have a job! A real one, with a contract!"

choices.t: Congratulate him
choices.then: He hugs you, nearly lifting you off the floor.

choices.t: Invite him to celebrate
choices.then: Tea, cake and a toast to "the first contract".

title: Timur moves on
text: A cousin in another city has a flat and a job offer. Timur packs his bag. "Thank you for everything," he says, and hands you the rice cooker.

choices.t: Hug him and promise to visit
choices.then: You wave from the doorway. A good chapter closes.

choices.t: Keep the rice cooker and cook for yourself
choices.then: Every time you cook, you think of him.

title: Babushka Valya and the pie
text: The old woman from flat 12 knocks with a plate of cabbage pirozhki. "You look thin, dear. Eat."

choices.t: Thank her and chat on the doorstep
choices.then: She tells you the story of the building since 1971. You promise to come for tea.

choices.t: Accept the pie and say you are busy
choices.then: The pie is delicious. The guilt is not.

title: Valya needs medicine
text: Valya calls you through the door: her knees hurt and she cannot reach the pharmacy. "Only if it is not a trouble."

choices.t: Go to the pharmacy for her
choices.then: You return with ointment and drops. She pays you in jam and blessings.

choices.t: Show her how to order delivery on her phone
choices.then: It takes an hour, but she can now order her own medicine. She is proud of herself.

title: Valya falls
text: You hear a thud and a faint "help". Her door is unlocked; she lies on the kitchen floor, conscious but pale.

choices.t: Call 103 and stay with her
choices.then: The ambulance takes her to the hospital. You hold her hand until the doors close.

choices.t: Call a neighbour and 103 together
choices.then: Three of you in the corridor, one calling the ambulance, one fetching her pills. She will be fine.

title: Valya comes home
text: After two weeks in hospital, Valya returns, thinner and frailer, but in good spirits. She invites you for tea and a story.

choices.t: Visit her with flowers
choices.then: She tells you about her husband, a driver, and the dance where they met in 1968.

choices.t: Send a card and call her
choices.then: She is touched by the card and hangs it on the fridge.

title: Valya's gift
text: Valya leaves a jar of cherry jam outside your door with a note: "Thank you for the kindness."

choices.t: Thank her and promise to cook from it
choices.then: The first recipe, "Valya's pirozhki", comes out almost perfect. You cry a little.

choices.t: Offer to help her with the shopping every week
choices.then: It becomes a Saturday ritual. The building has a new rhythm.

title: A study partner called Aigul
text: In the library a girl with three highlighters asks if she can share your table. "I am Aigul. I am hopeless at statistics."

choices.t: Offer to study together
choices.then: You trade notes and jokes. Silence in the library has never been so loud.

choices.t: Let her sit but keep to yourself
choices.then: She nods. Both of you work in silence.

title: Exam week together
text: Aigul calls at midnight: "I will fail tomorrow! Please, just one hour?" Your own revision is not finished either.

choices.t: Spend the hour with her
choices.then: You both pass. You swear never to leave things so late again.

choices.t: Say you cannot, wish her luck
choices.then: She passes anyway. She says "no problem" in a small voice.

title: Aigul is struggling
text: Aigul confesses she is thinking of dropping out: money, homesickness and a flat that is too cold.

choices.t: Listen and help her apply for a hardship grant
choices.then: The form is long but the grant comes through. Aigul stays.

choices.t: Cheer her up with a night out
choices.then: Pancakes, karaoke and terrible singing. She laughs for the first time in weeks.

choices.t: Tell her to push through
choices.then: She nods stiffly. You cannot tell if it helped.

title: Aigul's family
text: Aigul invites you to her sister's birthday: "It would mean a lot."

choices.t: Go and bring a gift
choices.then: A table with twenty dishes, six grandmothers and a toast in your honour.

choices.t: Politely decline
choices.then: She smiles. "Maybe next time."

title: Graduation day
text: Caps, flowers and exams behind you. Aigul runs across the lawn and hugs you.

choices.t: Take a photo together
choices.then: A good photo of a good friend.

choices.t: Promise to start a study group
choices.then: The group grows to twelve people and lasts all year.

title: The landlord drops in
text: Mr. Petrov, in a worn jacket, checks the radiators and the kitchen tap. "Everything in order?" he asks, running a finger along the shelf.

choices.t: Show him the flat proudly
choices.then: He nods slowly. "Rare. Most tenants wreck the place."

choices.t: Ask him to give notice before coming
choices.then: He frowns, then agrees. "Fair enough."

title: The rent goes up
text: A message from Mr. Petrov: "From next month, ₽500 more per week. Prices are going up everywhere."

choices.t: Negotiate politely, mention your good record
choices.then: He grumbles and settles for ₽250 more.

choices.t: Accept without comment
choices.then: He is pleased. Your wallet is not.

choices.t: Refuse and threaten to move
choices.then: He looks away. "Then move." You keep the old rent for now, but the atmosphere is cold.

title: A burst pipe at midnight
text: Water pours from under the sink. You call Mr. Petrov at 1 a.m. He answers on the first ring.

choices.t: Shut the valve and wait for him
choices.then: He arrives with a toolbox and a thermos. By 3 a.m. it is fixed.

choices.t: Call a plumber yourself (₽4,000)
choices.then: It works, and he later refunds half. "You solve problems. I like that."

title: A six-month offer
text: Mr. Petrov offers a standard contract at the current price.

choices.t: Sign the longer contract
choices.then: A proper lease and a stamp. At least it is in writing.

choices.t: Keep it flexible
choices.then: You keep your freedom, he keeps his price.

title: He is selling the flat
text: Mr. Petrov calls with news: his daughter needs money for a flat of her own. He offers you first refusal.

choices.t: Ask about the price and a mortgage
choices.then: He gives you a fair price and an honest list of the flat's flaws. You thank him and go home to think.

choices.t: Start looking for another place
choices.then: You thank him for the years and start a viewing list.

title: The caretaker's advice
text: Rustam, the building's caretaker (dvornik), is clearing the entrance. "You are new here. Come, I will tell you how the city works."

choices.t: Listen to his tips
choices.then: Where the cheap shop is, which bus never comes, who to call when the heating fails.

choices.t: Thank him and hurry on
choices.then: He waves and returns to his shovel.

title: A snow shovel
text: It snowed all night. Rustam is alone with a mountain of snow in front of the building.

choices.t: Help him clear the entrance
choices.then: An hour of shovelling; hot tea from his thermos afterwards.

choices.t: Thank him from the window with a wave
choices.then: He waves back with a shovel. Quiet respect.

title: A tip about a job
text: Rustam mentions that his cousin runs a small firm that needs a reliable person. "I can put in a word."

choices.t: Ask him to introduce you
choices.then: A short meeting and a trial day. Rustam's word counts for a lot.

choices.t: Thank him but decline
choices.then: He nods: "Another time then."

title: Rustam's daughter's wedding
text: Rustam invites everybody in the building to his daughter's wedding.

choices.t: Go with a gift envelope (₽3,000)
choices.then: Three hundred guests, two hundred dishes, one very loud band. You dance until you cannot feel your feet.

choices.t: Send a card and a small gift
choices.then: He thanks you warmly, a little sorry not to see you.

title: Rustam hangs up the shovel
text: After twenty years Rustam is retiring to his village. A farewell for the whole building is arranged on the stairs.

choices.t: Give a farewell speech
choices.then: You say a few words. Rustam smiles and shakes your hand.

choices.t: Organise a collection for a gift
choices.then: Three hundred roubles from each flat buys a new coat. He wears it on the train home.

title: A new colleague, Sergey
text: Sergey joined last week. He is quick, sure of himself and has already corrected you twice in front of the manager.

choices.t: Ask him to show you what you missed
choices.then: He is surprised, then flattered. Within an hour he has shown you two shortcuts.

choices.t: Compete: do better than him tomorrow
choices.then: You arrive early and work flat out. The manager notices both of you.

title: Credit for your idea
text: In a meeting Sergey presents an idea you mentioned at lunch, with no mention of you. The manager nods approvingly.

choices.t: Speak to Sergey privately
choices.then: He turns red: "I did not realise... I will tell the manager."

choices.t: Say it out loud in the meeting
choices.then: An awkward silence. The manager says "good, you both contributed". Sergey avoids you for a week.

choices.t: Let it go
choices.then: You swallow it and keep your head down. It bothers you for days.

title: Sergey is in trouble
text: Sergey made a costly mistake and the manager is furious. He looks at you across the room, pale.

choices.t: Help him fix it
choices.then: You spend the evening together. The mistake is repaired before the morning. He owes you.

choices.t: Keep out of it
choices.then: You are safe. He notices.

title: A promotion for one
text: The manager announces that one of you will be promoted next month. The room goes quiet.

choices.t: Prepare your best results
choices.then: You give a strong presentation. The manager says "we will think about it".

choices.t: Ask for feedback instead
choices.then: The manager lists your strengths and one weakness. You write them down.

title: Sergey invites you to the banya
text: Sergey: "No hard feelings. A team outing on Saturday, come if you want."

choices.t: Go and bring a thermos of tea
choices.then: Steam, birch twigs, jokes and a very honest conversation about work. You are a team now.

choices.t: Politely decline
choices.then: He nods. "Another time."

title: A retired teacher offers help
text: Olga Petrovna, a retired Russian-language teacher, notices you struggling with a form at the post office and corrects it kindly. "I give free lessons on Tuesdays at the community centre," she says.

choices.t: Go to the first lesson
choices.then: A room with a blackboard, a samovar and six students from five countries. She writes "здравствуйте" in careful chalk.

choices.t: Say you will think about it
choices.then: She smiles and gives you a leaflet.

title: The case system
text: Today Olga Petrovna explains the six cases. Half the class looks at the ceiling. "Do not fear," she says. "Everyone is afraid of the instrumental case."

choices.t: Practise with flashcards every evening
choices.then: By the end of the week you can say "I am going to the doctor with my friend" in four forms.

choices.t: Copy the table into your notebook and hope
choices.then: You will need to see it again.

title: A tea and a story
text: After class Olga Petrovna invites you to tea. She tells you about teaching in a village school fifty years ago and about her own travels.

choices.t: Listen and ask questions in Russian
choices.then: You use five new words and make three mistakes. She corrects you gently every time.

choices.t: Bring something from your own country to share
choices.then: She tastes it and says it is the best thing she has eaten this year. You believe her, a little.

title: Preparing for the test
text: Olga Petrovna says: "The language, history and law test is soon. Let us do a rehearsal." She prints a mock exam with a stern look.

choices.t: Do a full mock exam under time limit
choices.then: Two hours later you are tired and much more confident. She marks every error in green. (Your chance of passing the real test goes up.)

choices.t: Ask her for the key phrases only
choices.then: She gives you a one-page list. It helps, a little.

title: A farewell present
text: The course is ending. Olga Petrovna gives each student a small book of Russian proverbs, signed in her round handwriting.

choices.t: Thank her and promise to keep practising
choices.then: The book sits on your shelf, and her handwriting is the first thing you see in the morning.

choices.t: Offer to help her teach the next group
choices.then: She hesitates, then says yes. A volunteer teacher, you are already a part of the story.

title: A ginger cat at the door
text: A thin ginger cat sits by your entrance every evening, staring at the door with great dignity.

choices.t: Put out a saucer of milk and some fish
choices.then: The cat eats with great solemnity and then leaves without saying thank you.

choices.t: Ignore it
choices.then: The cat watches you pass. You feel judged.

title: The cat is limping
text: One morning the cat limps to the door and cries. Its paw is swollen.

choices.t: Take it to the vet (₽3,500)
choices.then: A splinter and an infection. The vet gives an injection and a pill. The cat hates you for an hour and then forgives you.

choices.t: Wash the paw and wait
choices.then: It heals slowly, and you spend three evenings with a cat on your lap.

title: What to call a cat
text: The neighbours are arguing over the cat's name: Ryzhik (Ginger), Barsik or Mikhalych.

choices.t: Vote for Ryzhik
choices.then: The name sticks. Soon half the building calls it by name.

choices.t: Suggest a name in your own language
choices.then: The cat answers to it at once. The neighbours are charmed.

title: Ginger and the neighbour's dog
text: A big dog barks at Ginger in the courtyard. Ginger arches up, hisses and rushes to your door.

choices.t: Carry the cat inside and calm the dog's owner
choices.then: Everyone is calm in ten minutes. The dog owner brings a bag of cat food as an apology.

choices.t: Let them sort it out
choices.then: Ginger wins by speed, and the dog retreats looking embarrassed.

title: Ginger moves in?
text: Ginger sits by your door every evening and meows to be let in.

choices.t: Let Ginger in for good
choices.then: The first night the cat inspects every corner, then curls up on your pillow. You sleep badly and happily.

choices.t: Keep feeding Ginger at the door
choices.then: An arrangement works for both of you: a cat of the courtyard, fed by the whole building.

title: A taxi driver with opinions
text: The driver, Vladimir, has a thermos, an icon on the dashboard and a view on everything. "You are new in the city," he says. "I can tell by how you look at the buildings."

choices.t: Ask him what to see in the city
choices.then: He lists three places no guidebook mentions, and a fourth where the soup is good.

choices.t: Look at your phone and nod
choices.then: He turns the radio up a little. The ride is quiet.

title: The shortcut
text: Vladimir says: "I know a shortcut through the courtyards that saves ten minutes. The map does not know it."

choices.t: Let him take it
choices.then: Through an arch, past a bakery, across a car park: you arrive early. You learn the route.

choices.t: Insist on the maps app route
choices.then: He shrugs. You arrive on time, a little stiffly.

title: He forgot his wallet
text: At the end of a ride Vladimir looks stricken: his card reader is broken and he cannot give change for your note.

choices.t: Tell him to keep the change
choices.then: He puts his hand on his chest. "I will remember this."

choices.t: Wait while he finds change
choices.then: It takes five minutes and an apology. You are fair, he is grateful.

title: A call at midnight
text: Your phone rings at 23:40. It is Vladimir: "I have a passenger who says he is lost and has no phone. Do you know the address?"

choices.t: Say you cannot help
choices.then: He sighs and thanks you anyway.

choices.t: Suggest calling the police for lost people
choices.then: He nods slowly and does so.

title: A job offer
text: Vladimir says he is retiring to his dacha and his taxi company needs reliable people. "You would be good. You are patient, you ask questions."

choices.t: Ask about the conditions
choices.then: A polite introduction and a standard trial.

choices.t: Thank him and decline
choices.then: He shakes your hand. "If you change your mind, ask for Vladimir."

title: A person you keep meeting
text: In the corridor, at the coffee machine and at the bus stop you keep meeting Zarina, who always has a book. Today she says: "We should stop pretending we do not know each other."

choices.t: Say hello and ask what she reads
choices.then: She reads poetry, mostly Akhmatova and Mandelstam. You spend ten minutes on a bench.

choices.t: Nod politely and go on
choices.then: She smiles and returns to her book.

title: A coffee after work
text: Zarina suggests a coffee on Friday. "Not a date," she says quickly. "Probably not a date."

choices.t: Say yes and choose a quiet café
choices.then: Two hours go by in what feels like twenty minutes. Nobody checks a phone.

choices.t: Suggest a walk instead
choices.then: A walk along the river. Her laugh is louder than you expected.

title: A misunderstanding
text: You forget to reply to Zarina for a day. She writes: "Okay. I understand." The tone of the message is cold.

choices.t: Call her and explain honestly
choices.then: You were overwhelmed with work. She is quiet, then forgives you with a joke.

choices.t: Send a long message with excuses
choices.then: She reads it and answers with a single emoji. You are not sure what it means.

choices.t: Let it pass
choices.then: The silence lasts a week. You see her at the bus stop and both look at the sky.

title: Meet the friends
text: Zarina invites you to her friends' evening: "They want to meet you."

choices.t: Go and bring something to share
choices.then: Salad, music, an argument about films. Her friends approve, loudly.

choices.t: Politely decline, you are tired
choices.then: She understands, but looks at her phone a bit longer than usual.

title: What are we?
text: On a bench by the river Zarina says: "I like you. I think you like me. So what are we?"

choices.t: Say you want to be together
choices.then: She hesitates, then nods slowly. "Let us try."

choices.t: Say you need time
choices.then: She nods. "Take your time. I will be reading Akhmatova."

title: Office hours
text: Professor Belova, the head of the department, leaves a note on your desk: "Office hours, room 312, Thursday. Please come."

choices.t: Go with a prepared question
choices.then: She tilts her glasses. "At last, a student who prepares."

choices.t: Go and ask what she wants
choices.then: She wanted to talk about your last assignment. It was not bad.

title: A research project
text: Professor Belova offers: "I need a student for a small research project. Unpaid, but it will look good on your CV and you will learn."

choices.t: Accept
choices.then: Hours in the library and an unexpected love of footnotes.

choices.t: Decline, you are too busy
choices.then: She nods. "The offer stands until the end of term."

title: A hard conversation
text: The professor asks to see you: "Your results have dropped. Is everything all right?"

choices.t: Tell her honestly about the stress
choices.then: She listens, then gives you an extension and the number of the student counsellor.

choices.t: Say it is nothing
choices.then: She looks unconvinced. "My door is open."

title: A conference
text: Professor Belova mentions a student conference. "You could apply."

choices.t: Go and present
choices.then: You are terrified for ten minutes and then you are not. Someone asks a good question.

choices.t: Skip it this year
choices.then: She does not scold you. "Next year, then."

title: A letter of recommendation
text: At the end of term Professor Belova hands you a sealed envelope. "I have written a recommendation. Use it well."

choices.t: Thank her and read it later
choices.then: A short, polite letter. It will help.

choices.t: Thank her and ask what she would advise next
choices.then: She tells you about her own first year: the failure, the doubt, the stubbornness.

title: Dad knows a guy
text: Your father puts down his phone. "I spoke to Viktor Palych. There is an internship at his firm. You start Monday. No need to thank me."

choices.t: Accept the internship gladly
choices.then: It is a real office with a real desk. Everyone knows whose child you are. You feel it in every handshake.

choices.t: Say you will find your own way
choices.then: He raises an eyebrow, then shrugs. "As you like."

title: A favour asked in return
text: At the internship Viktor Palych says, smiling: "Your father and I help each other. Maybe you can ask him to sign one small paper for my nephew?"

choices.t: Pass the message on
choices.then: It is just a paper, you tell yourself. You wonder how many "just papers" there are.

choices.t: Say that you do not mix work with your father's business
choices.then: The smile freezes for a second. Then he nods. "Principled. Good."

title: The call after the traffic stop
text: A traffic officer stops your friend's car. The friend, panicking, says: "Call your dad, please. He knows people."

choices.t: Call your father
choices.then: Within five minutes the officer waves them on. Your friend is grateful. You feel a little sick.

choices.t: Advise your friend to show the documents and ask for the protocol
choices.then: It takes an hour, ends with a small fine, and your friend says: "You are right. It was fair."

title: A friend needs a place
text: A friend from a small town has scored very well on the exams but has no connections. A place on a budget programme depends on one conversation your father could have.

choices.t: Ask your father to put in a word
choices.then: He is happy that you ask. The friend gets in. Nobody asks why.

choices.t: Help your friend prepare the application and the portfolio instead
choices.then: Three evenings of writing and rehearsing. The friend gets in by merit, and both of you know it.

title: Your own path
text: Your father says at dinner: "I have arranged something bigger. A position with a title." You realise you have never earned anything yet.

choices.t: Decline the position and earn your first real salary
choices.then: He is stunned, then proud, then offended, in that order. You start from the bottom of another ladder.

choices.t: Accept the position and use it well
choices.then: You decide that a door is a door and what matters is what you do once you walk through it.

title: Mum calls on Sunday
text: Mum calls every Sunday at nine. Today she asks, as always: "Have you eaten? Is it warm there? Are you keeping to your lessons?" There is a pause. "I am fine. Do not worry."

choices.t: Stay on the phone for an hour
choices.then: She tells you about the neighbours, the cat, and the price of buckwheat. You laugh and want to cry.

choices.t: Promise to call back tomorrow
choices.then: She says "of course" in a very small voice.

title: A little money from the big city
text: You have saved a little. Mum's birthday is in a week, and the boiler in her flat has been broken for a month.

choices.t: Send ₽8,000 for a new boiler
choices.then: She protests for ten minutes and cries for two. The boiler is installed on Thursday.

choices.t: Send ₽2,000 and a card
choices.then: It is what you can do. She frames the card.

choices.t: Wait until you have more money
choices.then: You tell yourself you will do more later. The guilt walks with you.

title: New Year at home
text: Trains to your hometown are crowded before the holiday. A ticket costs ₽5,000 one way. Mum has not said anything, but you know she is setting a table for two.

choices.t: Go home for New Year
choices.then: Olivier salad, tangerines, a tiny tree and Mum in her best dress. Snow outside, warmth inside.

choices.t: Stay and work the holiday shifts
choices.then: The money is good and the video call at midnight is short and cheerful.

title: A scare
text: The neighbour calls instead of Mum: "She felt dizzy and the doctor says it is her blood pressure. She does not want you to worry."

choices.t: Call the doctor and arrange help from afar
choices.then: The doctor is kind. A neighbour agrees to check in daily. It is not enough, but it is something.

choices.t: Send money for private tests and stay put
choices.then: The tests show nothing serious. You exhale for the first time in two days.

title: What Mum wants
text: On the phone, Mum says: "Whatever you decide, I only want you to be happy. Do not come back for me. Build your life." She goes quiet. You hear a kettle.

choices.t: Tell her that you will visit every holiday
choices.then: A promise is a bridge. She puts the kettle down and says "I will bake."

choices.t: Tell her that you will bring her to live near you one day
choices.then: She laughs, then asks: "Is there a place for the cat?" You say yes. It is your first plan for the future.

title: The woman on the bench
text: Every evening a small woman in a headscarf sits on the bench by your entrance. Today she looks at you for a long time. "You walk by every day and say nothing. Are you from here? Did nobody teach you to say good evening?"

choices.t: Say good evening and introduce yourself
choices.then: Her name is Valentina Petrovna. She nods slowly, as if you had passed an exam.

choices.t: Nod politely and keep walking
choices.then: She sighs. "Young people."

title: A small favour
text: Valentina Petrovna stops you at the door. Her shopping bag is heavy and her flat is on the fifth floor. "The lift again. Would you mind?"

choices.t: Carry the bag up the stairs
choices.then: She is surprised and says nothing, but the next day there is a jar of jam on your door handle.

choices.t: Say you are in a hurry
choices.then: She says "of course, of course" in a voice that suggests she does not mind, but she does.

title: The light is off
text: For three days there has been no light under her door and the bench stands empty in the frost. A neighbour says she has caught a cold and does not like to trouble anyone.

choices.t: Knock and ask if she needs anything
choices.then: She says she is fine, takes a few tablets and thanks you more warmly than you expected.

choices.t: Leave a note with your phone number
choices.then: She calls on the fourth day and says it was nothing. You agree, a bit relieved.

title: Her grandson
text: Valentina Petrovna introduces you to her grandson, a quiet teenager with a notebook. "Do you tutor maths, by any chance? You look clever, I can see." She looks at you hopefully.

choices.t: Offer a couple of free lessons
choices.then: The boy understands fractions at last. Valentina Petrovna sends a plate of pies after each lesson.

choices.t: Suggest a paid tutor from the school
choices.then: She says "of course" and that is the end of the matter.

title: Spring on the bench
text: In April Valentina Petrovna is on the bench again. She watches you walk by and, for the first time, says "Good evening" first.

choices.t: Stop and answer her greeting
choices.then: It takes thirty seconds. You walk on feeling oddly lighter.

choices.t: Smile and promise to come tomorrow
choices.then: Tomorrow becomes next week. She will remember.

title: Winter exam session
text: The exam session starts. Students around you carry notebooks, energy drinks and the glassy look of the sleepless. You are glad (or sorry) it is not your turn.

choices.t: Wish your friends luck
choices.then: You send a message and a sticker of a cat. Someone replies with three stars.

title: One year in Russia
text: It is 1 September, a year since you arrived. Goals reached: 1 of 15 (finish with zero legal strikes). Status: a labour migrant. Money: ₽45,000. Friends: 1. Achievements: 0 of 45. Still open on the first-month checklist: 8.

choices.t: Sit with a cup of tea and think it over
choices.then: You write down three things you are proud of and one thing you want to change. The tea goes cold and you do not mind.

choices.t: Celebrate with friends
choices.then: A table of salads, a cake with a single candle and a toast "to the next year". Somebody sings.

choices.t: Make a plan for the second year
choices.then: You list papers, money, people and dreams in four columns. The columns look possible.
